title: AudioResponse
description: A generated speech clip of at most 2 seconds: the AudioRequest fields, plus the fields set by the service. Returned by POST /audio, GET /audio/{id} and GET /audio/list, for library and generated sounds alike.

text.description: Text the speech was generated from (same as in the AudioRequest).

emotion.description: Emotion the text is spoken with (same as in the AudioRequest).

voiceId.description: Id of the Gradium voice the service chose for this clip.

clipUrl.description: Public CDN URL of the mp3 file (CDN to be decided).
